newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures, except for the spot October contract, were lower in the after-hours session on Wednesday after unexpected falls in Japan's rubber stocks lifted prices during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.1 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark March was down 0.1 yen at 136.7 yen. Volume was 6,693 lots.

During the day, prices edged up as active short-covering in the spot October contract spilled over into other contracts. A decline in Japan's rubber stocks as of October 10th and a weak yen were cited as positive factors, the traders said.
